content:
**NCAA Men’s Basketball – Final Four (2019 – 2023)**  

| Year | University (Team) | Mascot (nickname) |
|------|-------------------|-------------------|
| **2019** | University of Virginia – **Cavaliers** | **CavMan** (the Cavalier) |
| | Texas Tech University – **Red Raiders** | **Raider Red** |
| | Auburn University – **Tigers** | **Aubie** (the Tiger) |
| | Michigan State University – **Spartans** | **Sparty** |
| **2021** | Gonzaga University – **Bulldogs** | **Spike** |
| | Baylor University – **Bears** | **Bruiser** (and “Lady Bear”) |
| | University of Houston – **Cougars** | **Shasta** |
| | University of California, Los Los – **Bruins** | **Joe Bruin** |
| **2022** | University of Kansas – **Jayhawks** | **Big Jay** |
| | University of North Carolina – **Tar Heels** | **Rameses** (the Ram) |
| | Duke University – **Blue Devils** | **Blue Devil** (often just “Blue Devil”) |
| | Villanova University – **Wildcats** | **Willie** (the Wildcat) |
| **2023** | University of Connecticut – **Huskies** | **Jonathan** (the Husky) |
| | San Diego State University – **Aztecs** | **Aztec Warrior** |
| | University of Miami (FL) – **Hurricanes** | **Sebastian** (the Ibis) |
| | Purdue University – **Boilermakers** | **Purdue Pete** |

### Quick notes
* The “team” name (e.g., **Cavaliers**, **Bulldogs**) is the nickname used for the athletic program.  
* The “mascot” listed is the official costumed character that appears at games and events.  
* The 2020 NCAA tournament was canceled due to the COVID‑19 pandemic, so there is no Final Four for that year.
